cells.gaps: No source since October 2023 says a digital or biometric roll is in service; the 2026 overhaul collects voter data mainly on paper (MDG-004), and an electoral agent said in August 2026 that no digitalisation was planned for it (MDG-005).
cells.note: Stage 4c 2026-11-08: a second report of the paper-based August 2026 overhaul (MDG-005) changes nothing under Bill's ruling of 2026-11-04 (messages-for-bill 73): Ceni received equipment for a biometric list in October 2026 (MDG-003), so a digital roll is under way and the manual roll does not block it. Stage 2.
